demo.title: guap.txt
demo.code:
You: connect guap K7QM-4XTD
Agent: (signs with your wallet) Open guap and tap Confirm. Check it shows 0xee47...D6B2.
You: cash out $20 to my bank
Agent: ₦27,300 to GTBank ••••4821. You send 20.04 USDC on Base. Go ahead?
You: yes
Agent: To send it, reply with: send 20.039136 USDC on base to 0x18A1...56BD
You: send 20.039136 USDC on base to 0x18A1...56BD
Agent: Sent. The naira has been paid into GTBank ••••4821.

setup: In guap (getguap.xyz), open Settings, Bankr, Connect Bankr, and say the code to your agent
Confirm on guap, then save the bank account you want naira in
Say: cash out $20 to my bank, and send the one line your agent gives you
